name: Chennai Institute of Technology (CIT)
summary: Chennai Institute of Technology, at Sarathy Nagar, Kundrathur, was founded in 2010. All its programmes are affiliated to Anna University and approved by AICTE, and it holds NAAC 'A+' accreditation. The college says it offers fourteen B.E./B.Tech programmes; Edugate lists the 13 it has verified. TNEA counselling code 1399.
